interface.title: Rastro: Treino (training mode of the Rastro brown-dwarf candidate reviewer)
interface.field: Astronomy: searching for nearby brown dwarfs and cool stars by their proper motion in CatWISE2020
interface.stage_of_work: Human vetting of candidates from an automated pipeline, practised here on cases whose answers are already known
interface.what_it_is_for: Drills a reviewer on classifying high-proper-motion candidates as confirm, doubt or discard from three image cutouts plus a catalogue checklist, then reveals the true label and tracks the reviewer's accuracy and bias by answer class.

data.note: Bundled demo/treino_demo.db with 40 known-answer cases: known L/T dwarfs such as SIPS J1232-0951 and 2MASS J11220826-3512363, SIMBAD stars such as LP 429-30, a SIMBAD galaxy, and Phase-3 quality-filter rejects. With no network, every unWISE, Legacy Surveys and WiseView image showed 'Recorte/Animação indisponível', or stayed on a loading spinner. The checklist numbers (PM, PM/σ, W1-W2, W2, Gaia G and G-W2, AllWISE test, Pan-STARRS) are stored with each case and always displayed. Case order and the accuracy history are per browser session: reloading the page started again at 'Acertos 0 de 0' with a different case 1 (screens/021.webp).

features.name: Known-answer classification drill with reveal
features.general: Present an item with its evidence, have the user commit to one of three labels, then reveal the true label, an explanation, and where the deciding clue was, with a right/wrong/partial verdict
features.specific: For each 'Caso N de 40', press Confirmar, Dúvida or Descartar; the panel turns into 'Resposta: Confirmado/Descartado' with the object name, an 'Onde estava a pista' box, and 'Errou: você marcou …', 'Meio ponto: a dúvida vale metade' or 'Você acertou'
steps: inspect the candidate's images and checklist
press Confirmar, Dúvida or Descartar
read the revealed answer and the 'Onde estava a pista' explanation
see the verdict (correct, wrong, or half point for Dúvida)
press Próximo ▶ to load the next case
serves_tasks: Assign a label to the candidate
Read the revealed true answer, the explanation and where the clue was

features.name: Per-class accuracy and bias panel
features.general: Summarise a rater's accuracy overall, over a recent window with a change indicator, and separately for each true class, so a lopsided bias such as accepting everything becomes visible
features.specific: The 'Seu histórico' expander shows Geral, 'Últimas N' with a '+N pontos' delta, 'Quando era Confirmado' and 'Quando era Descartado' (the ? icons give case counts), plus a note that Dúvida counts half and that very different 'Quando era' columns indicate bias
steps: answer one or more cases
expand 'Seu histórico'
compare 'Quando era Confirmado' with 'Quando era Descartado'
hover the ? icons to see how many cases each figure rests on
serves_tasks: Check overall and recent accuracy, and accuracy split by true class, to spot bias

features.name: Rolling-window proficiency gate
features.general: Show a running score bar and a level badge that tells the user how many more answers they need, and at what accuracy over a sliding window, before they reach the next level
features.specific: The header 'Acertos X de N' bar and the 'Nível: Aprendiz. Para "Treino em dia" (80% nas últimas 20): faltam N respostas' banner, updated after every answer. Only the first level, 'Aprendiz', was seen
steps: answer a case
the 'Acertos' bar updates (Dúvida adds 0.5)
the banner's 'faltam N respostas' counts down toward the 20-answer window
serves_tasks: Track progress toward the calibrated-reviewer threshold

features.name: Side-by-side evidence images with guiding questions
features.general: Show several complementary images of one object side by side, each with its own yes/no question for the reviewer to answer by eye
features.specific: Infrared unWISE NEO7 W1+W2, optical Legacy Surveys DR10 grz and WiseView W2-by-epoch motion panels titled '1. Infravermelho / 2. Óptico / 3. Movimento'. Unverified offline: every panel showed 'Recorte/Animação indisponível' or a spinner, so only the titles and questions were seen
steps: read each panel's guiding question
look at the infrared cutout for a compact reddish source
look at the optical cutout for a counterpart
watch the motion animation for consistent movement
serves_tasks: Look at the three images of the candidate: infrared cutout, optical cutout and multi-epoch motion animation

features.name: Criteria checklist with cross-check suggestion
features.general: Show key catalogue metrics and a pass/warn/fail checklist for an object, next to an automated suggestion that is meant only as a cross-check on the human judgement
features.specific: Metric tiles (Movimento próprio, Significância, Cor W1-W2, W2), ✅/⚠️/❌ items for PM/σ ≥ 15, Teste do AllWISE, Gaia G-W2, Cor W1-W2 and Óptico Pan-STARRS, and a 'Sugestão do pipeline' badge whose caveat says it only counts if the two human tests pass
steps: read the metric tiles
scan the checklist for ❌ items (Gaia too blue, AllWISE static)
compare your view with 'Sugestão do pipeline' before answering
serves_tasks: Weigh the catalogue checklist and the automated suggestion

features.name: Case pager with stored answers
features.general: Step forward and back through a fixed queue of items, where items already answered show their stored answer and feedback instead of the answer buttons
features.specific: ◀ Anterior / Próximo ▶ buttons with the 'Caso N de 40' counter; going back to case 1 showed its stored answer and the 'Errou' verdict with no buttons to answer again, and ◀ Anterior is disabled there
steps: press Próximo ▶ to advance
press ◀ Anterior to revisit an answered case
see the stored answer and feedback in place of the answer buttons
serves_tasks: Move on to the next item, or go back to an earlier one

features.name: Reference guide with good/bad example pairs
features.general: A collapsible guide that explains how to read each kind of evidence and what decides a case, with a good and a bad example side by side for each evidence type
features.specific: The 'O que procurar em cada imagem (com exemplos)' expander, open on load and on case 1, with 'Como ler as imagens', 'O que decide' and ✅ Bom / ❌ Ruim pairs for 1. Infravermelho, 2. Óptico and 3. Movimento. Offline, the example images showed 'Imagem indisponível' and only their captions could be read
steps: open the expander (it is open on first load)
read 'Como ler as imagens' and 'O que decide'
compare the ✅ Bom and ❌ Ruim captions for each evidence type
collapse the expander to get to the case
serves_tasks: Read the reference guide on what counts as good or bad evidence in each image
